summary: The note examines how small and medium enterprises (SMEs) can raise productivity and efficiency for sustainable growth after September 2023. It draws on named experts and examples covering AI, financial management, green technology, talent, Kaizen, digital transformation, innovation culture and partnerships. It concludes that SMEs must stay agile and tech-savvy, as efficiency is becoming necessary for survival.
one_line: Overview of how SMEs can boost productivity and sustainability through AI, finance, green tech, talent, continuous improvement, digitalization and collaboration.
key_facts: Rebecca Huang runs a small manufacturing unit that combined artificial intelligence with skilled labor; in early November 2023 her facility showed this blend of technology and human ingenuity.
Rebecca Huang's AI helps predict supply chain disruptions, optimize inventory management, and give insights into customer behavior trends, boosting productivity while keeping costs tight.
Andrew Mkhize, a financial expert with over a decade of experience working with SMEs, stresses diligent cash flow management and access to fluid capital.
In his December 2023 webinar, Andrew Mkhize recommended digital accounting solutions and alternative funding such as crowdfunding, peer-to-peer lending, and government grants for SME development.
On January 15, 2024, GreenTech Innovations, led by CEO Emily Tsai, unveiled its 'Eco-SME' suite for analyzing and reducing carbon footprints and promoting renewable energy use.
Emily Tsai views sustainability as a strategic investment, citing reduced energy costs, regulatory compliance, and a positive public image as benefits.
On February 20, 2024, human resource consultant Martin Schultz launched 'SME Talent Hub,' a platform connecting SMEs with professionals seeking flexible or part-time roles.
Lean management expert Jordan Lee promotes the Kaizen approach, a Japanese term for 'change for the better,' which improves processes through incremental changes without large up-front investment.
At a March 8, 2024 seminar, Jordan Lee cited a case study of an SME that achieved a 15% increase in productivity by reorganizing its shop floor layout.

At the Digital Frontier Conference on April 12, 2024, Laura Perez, CTO of an ecommerce startup, said a digital-first strategy using cloud computing, big data analytics and IoT led to a 30% rise in year-over-year revenue.
At the Future of SMEs summit on May 4, 2024, innovation strategist Alexei Novikov said innovation is about mindset as well as technology, and that SMEs must take calculated risks.

The note gives examples of cross-industry collaboration: fashion retailers working with tech startups on inventory algorithms, and food manufacturers partnering with logistics companies to streamline distribution.
